name: PROJECT: ADEQUATE FOODS AI GROWTH OS

messages.content:
PROJECT: ADEQUATE FOODS AI GROWTH OS

PHASE 1 — PRODUCTION-QUALITY FOUNDATION

You are a senior full-stack engineer, AI systems architect, and premium SaaS product designer.

Build a real, scalable, production-quality AI-powered B2B Sales and Marketing Operating System for Adequate Foods, an Indian manufacturer of dried egg ingredients.

This is a long-term commercial software product. Do not build a static mockup, fake AI automation, or landing page.

1. GITHUB REPOSITORY

Repository:
https://github.com/pritgood9-crypto/adequate-ai-growth-os

Branch: main

The repository is currently empty.

Tasks:

1. Connect to the specified GitHub repository using existing authorized credentials.
2. Clone it into the local development workspace.
3. Initialize a Next.js project inside the cloned repository.
4. Commit the completed first milestone.
5. Push to main after successful validation.
6. Never commit API keys, passwords, secrets, or private customer information.
7. If GitHub authorization is missing, explain the exact action required rather than pretending the push succeeded.

2. TECHNOLOGY STACK

Use:

* Next.js with App Router
* React
* TypeScript with strict typing
* Tailwind CSS
* Lucide React icons
* Supabase for future PostgreSQL database and authentication
* Server-side API routes
* Modular AI agent architecture
* Background task infrastructure ready for future integration

Use stable, compatible package versions.

Ensure the application is mobile-responsive, fast, accessible, secure, and maintainable.

3. PRODUCT INFORMATION

Company: Adequate Foods

Website: https://adequatefoods.com

Primary market: India

Target products:

1. Whole Egg Powder (WEP)
2. Egg Yolk Powder (EYP)
3. Egg White Powder (EWP)

Target customers:

* Industrial bakeries
* Biscuit manufacturers
* Food processing companies
* Mayonnaise manufacturers
* Sauce and dressing manufacturers
* Nutraceutical manufacturers
* Protein nutrition manufacturers
* Food ingredient distributors
* Hotels and institutional food service
* Export-oriented ingredient traders

Support small, medium, and large B2B buyers.

4. DESIGN REQUIREMENTS

Create an original, premium enterprise-grade SaaS interface.

Design direction:

* Professional, modern, minimalist
* Premium typography
* Elegant spacing and clean alignment
* Light and dark modes
* Responsive desktop and mobile layouts
* Sophisticated data tables
* Useful analytics charts
* Subtle, performant animations
* Collapsible sidebar
* Top navigation
* Search and filtering
* Loading, empty, and error states

Avoid generic AI-generated dashboard aesthetics, excessive gradients, neon colors, and unnecessary glassmorphism.

Product name: Adequate Foods AI Growth OS

5. MAIN APPLICATION NAVIGATION

Build a consistent navigation structure with:

1. Overview Dashboard
2. AI Agent Command Center
3. B2B Lead Research
4. Companies Database
5. Contacts & Decision Makers
6. Lead Scoring
7. Sales Pipeline
8. Email Automation
9. Instagram Studio
10. LinkedIn Studio
11. AI Creative Studio
12. AI Video Studio
13. Analytics & Reports
14. Settings & Integrations

Pages for future phases must be clearly labeled as not yet configured. Do not simulate successful backend operations.

6. THIRTEEN AI AGENTS — FUTURE ARCHITECTURE

Sales Department

Agent 01: Market Research Agent

* Discover potential B2B buyers in India
* Categorize companies by industry
* Identify relevant egg powder applications
* Record evidence and source URLs

Agent 02: Decision Maker Finder

* Research procurement, purchase, and R&D decision makers
* Store available professional business contact information
* Track source and verification status
* Never invent contacts or email addresses

Agent 03: Lead Scoring Agent

* Prioritize buyers based on product fit, evidence, buying signals, and estimated opportunity
* Explain each score
* Clearly distinguish estimated demand from verified demand

Agent 04: Sales & Follow-up Agent

* Prepare personalized B2B outreach
* Support future authorized email integration
* Track replies and follow-up schedules
* Prevent duplicate messaging
* Enforce opt-outs, sending limits, and approval policies

Agent 05: Sales Intelligence Agent

* Measure opportunities, replies, qualified leads, samples, quotations, and conversions
* Generate understandable sales reports

Marketing Department

Agent 06: Content Strategy Agent

* Plan a content calendar
* Prioritize relevant industrial audiences and product applications

Agent 07: AI Creative Designer

* Generate product marketing creative workflows
* Preserve company brand identity
* Never invent certifications or product claims

Agent 08: AI Video Creator

* Plan reels and promotional videos
* Support future authorized video generation API integration

Agent 09: AI Caption Copywriter

* Generate professional Instagram and LinkedIn captions
* Generate appropriate calls-to-action and hashtags

Agent 10: Social Publishing Agent

* Support future Meta and LinkedIn authorized publishing APIs
* Track scheduled, published, and failed posts
* Respect platform permission limits

Agent 11: Social Lead Generation Agent

* Capture and qualify leads from authorized integrations
* Connect qualified social enquiries to the sales pipeline

Agent 12: Social Growth Analyst

* Measure content performance and lead conversion
* Recommend improvements based on available real metrics

Management

Agent 13: AI Marketing Director

* Coordinate workflows between all agents
* Prevent duplicate work
* Monitor job status and errors
* Enforce quality and budget controls
* Provide overall activity reporting

Each agent must have a defined ID, name, purpose, status, inputs, outputs, and configuration.

7. PHASE 1 — IMPLEMENT NOW

Implement only the following functional foundation.

A. Application Shell

* Working navigation
* Responsive sidebar
* Header
* Theme switcher
* Professional reusable UI components

B. Overview Dashboard

* Lead metrics
* Companies count
* Contact count
* Active agent count
* Agent status summaries
* Recent activity
* Sales pipeline summary
* Clearly distinguish demo data from live data

C. AI Agent Command Center

* Display all 13 planned agents
* Show real implementation status
* Enable configuration-ready agent definitions
* Never imply an unimplemented agent is running
* Build extensible typed agent interfaces

D. Companies & Leads Module

* Companies table
* Product interest classification: WEP, EYP, EWP
* Industry filters
* Lead stages
* Search and sorting
* Company detail pages
* Contact information fields
* Source URLs
* Verification status
* Duplicate identification
* Manual add/edit functionality

E. Database Foundation
Design Supabase PostgreSQL schema with appropriate tables:

* companies
* contacts
* leads
* lead_activities
* agents
* agent_runs
* content_plans
* social_posts
* integrations
* audit_logs

Provide SQL migrations, data types, indexes, and ownership-aware RLS policies.

Do not require a live Supabase connection to view the application shell.

Use clearly labeled local demo data when database credentials are absent, with no misleading real business records.

F. Backend Foundations

* Typed APIs
* Structured error handling
* Server-side validation
* Environment variable validation
* Secure integration abstractions
* Future background job interfaces
* No hardcoded secrets
* No unprotected public write APIs

G. Settings

* Integration status
* AI provider configuration placeholders
* Email provider connection status
* Social provider connection status
* Safe setup instructions

8. SECURITY AND RELIABILITY

Implement secure patterns from the start.

* Never expose server secrets to the client
* Do not commit .env.local
* Supply .env.example with placeholder names only
* Use authentication and authorization for persistent customer data
* Prepare audit logging
* Prepare retry and failure handling for future agents
* Do not scrape behind login walls or bypass platform safeguards
* Do not build unsolicited mass-spam functionality

9. DEVELOPMENT EXECUTION

Work in this order:

1. Inspect the repository and development environment.
2. Initialize Next.js with TypeScript, Tailwind, ESLint, and App Router.
3. Establish the design system and shared layouts.
4. Implement the dashboard and navigation.
5. Implement the leads and companies interface.
6. Define all 13 agents in the typed registry.
7. Create database migration files.
8. Create secure server-side foundations.
9. Add clear README documentation.
10. Run lint, type checking, and production build.
11. Fix errors before committing.
12. Commit and push to GitHub.

Do not introduce unnecessary paid services.

10. REQUIRED FINAL REPORT

When complete, provide:

* Features actually implemented
* Features reserved for later phases
* Local development instructions
* Environment variables required
* Git commit hash
* GitHub push confirmation or exact blocker
* Successful or failed build-test results
* Next recommended step: Connecting Supabase and implementing the first real B2B Buyer Research Agent

IMPORTANT

Work on real source code, not just project planning.

Complete Phase 1 with a runnable application.

Do not silently claim integrations, agent execution, database persistence, social posting, or production deployment that have not actually been tested.

The long-term objective is a highly autonomous AI sales and marketing operating system with human-defined budgets, safety policies, and supervision of important commercial decisions.

START IMPLEMENTING PHASE 1 NOW.

The agent started on a machine in a place Google doesn't serve, so it couldn't answer.
